acceptanceCriteria: When project instructions declare a verify command, affected and impact report it as the mandatory check (project authority outranks inferred commands), with tests for a Makefile-less npm repo.
Inferred commands that the instructions do not declare are labelled as inferred, not mandatory, with a test.
body: Found during the Beamfall Corvint setup rollout (2026-10-20, corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676). In beamfall-docs (no Makefile, package.json build), `corvint affected` advises no mandatory check and `corvint impact AGENTS.md` falls back to `git diff --check`; expected `npm run build` from the AGENTS.md **Verify:** line or package.json. In beamfall-web and beamfall-design-system impact lists `npm test` beside `make gate` although AGENTS.md declares only `make gate`.

title: affected/impact ignore a repo's declared verify command: no Makefile -> no mandatory check, and npm test is added beside a declared make gate
